findings.evidence: `private theorem contMDiff_of_contMDiff_coe_comp {f : HyperbolicSpace E → HyperbolicSpace E}`; its body needs the ascription `(f : HyperbolicSpace E → upperHalfSpace E)`, which only elaborates because the synonym is defeq-unfolded inside this file.
findings.fix: Make it public and state it as an iff for `f : M → HyperbolicSpace E` from an arbitrary manifold `M`, not just for self-maps.
findings.issue: `contMDiff_of_contMDiff_coe_comp` is `private` and restricted to self-maps, yet it is the only bridge for `C^n` maps *into* `HyperbolicSpace E`. Since `HyperbolicSpace` is a semireducible `def` (line 80), consumers cannot apply `TauCeti.ContMDiff.subtypeVal_comp_iff` (Subtype.lean:77) without unfolding the synonym, so no curve `ℝ → HyperbolicSpace E` can be shown smooth with the public API — exactly what later length/geodesic/volume work needs.

findings.evidence: Lines 252-258: `hcoe`, `mfderiv_comp_apply`, `rw [hcomp, h₂, mfderiv_coe_apply, mfderiv_coe_apply, hA.hasMFDerivAt.mfderiv]`; `TauCeti.Manifold.mfderiv_subtype_val` (Tangent.lean:550) is the only ingredient behind `mfderiv_coe_apply`.
findings.fix: Relocate the general form (`U V : Opens F`, `f : U → V`, `HasFDerivAt A L ↑x`, `Subtype.val ∘ f = A ∘ Subtype.val`, conclusion via `TauCeti.Manifold.tangentSpaceOpenEquiv`) to `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/ContMDiff/Subtype.lean` or `VectorBundle/Tangent.lean`, public, and keep a public hyperbolic restatement here since the synonym blocks direct use.
findings.issue: `tangentSpaceCastModel_mfderiv_apply` is general infrastructure hidden as `private`: its proof uses only `contMDiff_coe`, `mfderiv_coe_apply` and `mfderiv_comp_apply` — nothing about the half-space, the height, or the metric. The deferred isometries (inversions in spheres) and any other open-subset model space must re-prove it.

findings.evidence: Restriction.lean:318-348 provides the parallel trio `inner_tangentSpace_open`, `norm_tangentSpace_open`, `enorm_tangentSpace_open`, all `@[simp]`; Restriction.lean:369 shows `pathELength_eq_lintegral_mfderiv_Icc` consuming the enorm form.
findings.fix: Tag `inner_def` `@[simp]` and add `‖v‖ = ‖tangentSpaceCastModel 𝓘(ℝ, WithLp 2 (E × ℝ)) x v‖ / height x` plus its `‖·‖ₑ` form, mirroring `TauCeti.Manifold.norm_tangentSpace_open`/`enorm_tangentSpace_open`.
findings.issue: Characteristic API of the installed metric is incomplete: `inner_def` is the only instance-level lemma and it carries no `@[simp]` (the bundled `riemannianMetric_inner` cannot fire on `inner ℝ v w`), and there is no `norm`/`enorm` form, which every length computation needs since `pathELength` is a `lintegral` of `‖mfderiv …‖ₑ`.

findings.evidence: Lines 351-364: only `*` and `⁻¹` are covered, both untagged; `RiemannianIsometry.one_apply`/`mul_apply`/`inv_apply` are all `@[simp]` in Isometry/Group.lean:99-109, and `similarity_inv`'s proof re-derives the unit case inline.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem similarity_one : similarity 1 one_pos (0 : E) = 1` and tag `similarity_mul`/`similarity_inv` `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `similarity`'s interaction with the group operations is incomplete and unannotated: `similarity_mul` and `similarity_inv` are normal-form reductions but carry no `@[simp]` (unlike `coe_similarity_apply`/`height_similarity_apply`), and the unit law `similarity 1 _ 0 = 1` is missing, so the `1` of `Isom` is unconnected to the family.

summary: The metric and similarity surface is mostly right, but the type synonym hides the two bridges a consumer needs (maps into `HyperbolicSpace`, differentials of restricted ambient maps) behind `private`, and the characteristic API is incomplete: no `norm`/`enorm` form of the metric, `inner_def` unannotated, and no `similarity_one`/`simp` on the group laws.
